issues.title: SQLite Single-Writer Bottleneck
issues.why: The spec mandates SQLite-first with a 'Split DB' pattern but lacks explicit guidance on handling 'database is locked' errors during concurrent writes in the business logic examples.
issues.fix: Add a normative requirement for a retry-with-jitter policy (e.g., 3 attempts, 100ms base) for all write operations in the ORM/Service layer.

issues.title: Missing AC for Boolean Storage
issues.why: While §2.1 of 02-schema-design.md provides a detailed normative table for cross-language boolean storage, the Acceptance Criteria (97-acceptance-criteria.md) lacks a specific GWT test for verifying this across different language implementations.
issues.fix: Add AC-12: 'Given a boolean field, When persisted in SQLite and read in Go/PHP, Then it must be stored as INTEGER 0/1 and cast to native bool without string-coercion side effects.'
